Who this is for

For you if

  • You already make this kind of work
  • You want a standard, not a gallery
  • You can commit three hours a week

Not for you if

  • You want a certificate without the critique
  • You cannot attend any live session
  • You are looking for a software tutorial

Assessment and certificate

There is no exam. You are assessed on the artefact, presented in week six against the rubric you receive in week one. Certificates carry the cohort number, the hours and the faculty names, and can be verified from an ID.

Admissions asks us

Both exist. Individual courses are one-off purchases with lifetime access. The Live plan adds every live session, every replay and the library for a monthly or annual fee.

Every session is recorded and published to the archive within a few hours. Registrants get the replay automatically, along with any resources shared in the room.

Yes. Courses and cohorts issue a certificate of completion with a verifiable ID. Certificates name the course, the hours and the instructor.

Teams can purchase seats by invoice, with a purchase order and a single consolidated invoice. We also provide a written syllabus for procurement.
